cover_letter.greeting: Dear Galaxy Data Center Finance Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Associate, FP&A - Capex role on the Data Center Finance team. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt data center pipeline anchored by Helios, and this role sits where construction spend meets project financing. Data center and power finance is the area I most want to build a career in.

At Lenovo I built forecasts, models and scenario analyses on capital allocation that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and ran variance and sensitivity work on budget reallocation. At Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region. In my MBA work I modeled a 6-project, 35.4 MW solar portfolio, covering capital structure, DSCR, NPV and levered IRR, and compared debt structures for funding it.

I haven't worked in construction finance, so I'd be learning cost-to-complete and draw mechanics on the job. What I can bring from day one is disciplined forecasting, clean budget-vs-actual tracking, and a habit of keeping one reliable set of numbers across teams like Construction, Accounting and Treasury. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
